config.name: standard synthetic two-visit recovery benchmark
config.description: 45 synthetic homes, each needing an install then a battery day. 3 clusters, 2 install crews, 1 battery crew(s), 10 business days. Every number comes from a stated rule or source.

provenance.source: Rule-based generator v3, seed 42. Not customers.

parameters.name: workday
parameters.derivation: One 8-hour crew day

parameters.name: install_duration
parameters.derivation: Electrical disconnect visit of 1.5 to 3 hours, varied per home (seeded)

parameters.name: battery_day_duration
parameters.derivation: About 75 min to place one battery, so a battery crew fits 5 to 6 a day with travel

parameters.name: min_gap_install_to_battery_day
parameters.derivation: The battery day comes at least one business day after the install

parameters.name: crew_mix
parameters.derivation: Installs take longer per home, so two install crews feed one battery crew

parameters.name: battery_crew_start
parameters.derivation: Battery crews start after the first window day because no install is finished yet

parameters.name: ready_dates
parameters.derivation: Each home becomes ready on a uniform random day in the first N business days

parameters.name: deadline_rule
parameters.derivation: Battery-day deadline = ready date + N business days, capped at the last window day

parameters.name: business_days
parameters.derivation: Crews work weekdays that are not US federal holidays

parameters.name: overflow_days
parameters.derivation: Crew days after the window where late visits can still land

parameters.name: current_plan_rule
parameters.derivation: Current plan = this tool's strict plan for the undisrupted scenario, day 0 locked. Deliveries are sized to it

parameters.name: depot
parameters.derivation: Crew yard at the mean of the cluster centers

parameters.name: road_circuity
parameters.derivation: US nationwide driving distance / straight-line distance
parameters.source: Boscoe, Henry, Zdeb (2012). A Nationwide Comparison of Driving Distance Versus Straight-Line Distance to Hospitals. The Professional Geographer 64(2):188-196.

parameters.name: average_speed
parameters.derivation: Urban driving including stops

parameters.name: travel_N
parameters.derivation: (2 x depot-to-center + 2 x mean site radius) x circuity / speed, depot distance 7.30 km

parameters.name: travel_S
parameters.derivation: (2 x depot-to-center + 2 x mean site radius) x circuity / speed, depot distance 8.85 km

parameters.name: travel_W
parameters.derivation: (2 x depot-to-center + 2 x mean site radius) x circuity / speed, depot distance 6.77 km

parameters.name: deliveries
parameters.derivation: A delivery every N business days, sized to the planned battery days until the next

parameters.name: battery_capacity
parameters.derivation: Powerwall 3 nominal battery energy (13.5 kWh AC)

parameters.name: battery_charge_limit
parameters.derivation: Powerwall 3 maximum continuous charge power

parameters.name: battery_discharge_limit
parameters.derivation: Powerwall 3 nominal output power, highest rating

parameters.name: battery_round_trip
parameters.derivation: Powerwall 3 solar-to-battery-to-home/grid efficiency (typical solar shifting). The datasheet gives no grid-charge figure

parameters.name: battery_one_way_efficiency
parameters.derivation: Charge and discharge efficiency = sqrt(round trip)

parameters.name: battery_reserve
parameters.derivation: 10% of capacity held back; start and end at reserve

parameters.name: value_start
parameters.derivation: Energy value starts after the battery day; the install alone earns nothing

parameters.name: unscheduled_penalty
parameters.derivation: Delay charged for a home left unscheduled; larger than any lateness in the horizon

parameters.name: weather_thunder
parameters.derivation: Electrical work stops for lightning. A thunderstorm report in working hours loses the crew-day

parameters.name: weather_battery_day
parameters.derivation: Battery days stop for the same weather as installs; their sensitivity is untested

parameters.name: weather_heavy_rain
parameters.derivation: AMS heavy-rain threshold (0.30 in/h) in any working hour loses the crew-day

parameters.name: weather_working_hours
parameters.derivation: Hours in which weather can stop work

parameters.name: weather_station
parameters.derivation: Nearest ASOS station to the study area (Houston Hobby)

parameters.name: max_overtime_min
parameters.derivation: Demo limits added capacity to two hours per crew-day.

summary: Recovery approved for this analysis. The returned effective scenario preserves resource changes and bookings; no customers were contacted. This server accepts the new current plan, including its added capacity, until it restarts.
